name: Reverse Hack Squat
instructions: Stand on the hack squat platform facing the back pad, with your chest against the pad and the shoulder pads on top of your shoulders.
Put your feet about shoulder width apart in the middle of the platform. Hold the handles.
Straighten your legs to lift the sled, then release the safety handles.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower the sled until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform.
Keep your chest against the pad and your heels down.
Push through your whole foot to straighten your legs and squeeze your glutes at the top. Engage the safety handles when the set is done.
